purpose: Integrate the local Astronomicon Crown order into a global 10-organ crown-aware stage scoring overlay without claiming assembled state.
integration_law: One Crown-confirmed organ contributes 10/100 to organ-wide Red/Blue/Custodes/Throne stage signals.
Crown-aware overlay is global scoring evidence, but it does not overwrite assembled state.
Canonical v0.1 stage summary may remain unchanged; this overlay is explicit and separately named.
Launcher/TUI presence can count as 10/100 only for the organ with validated windowed aquarium TUI.

score_rules.red_team_score: 10 if Astronomicon red local hardening is 100 and Crown order is 100, else 0
score_rules.blue_team_score: 10 if Astronomicon blue local hardening is 100 and Crown order is 100, else 0
score_rules.custodes_organ_validators_score: 10 if Custodes Astronomicon validation is 100 with no indictments, else 0
score_rules.throne_organ_validators_score: 10 if Astronomicon Crown order is 100 and Throne self-validation is 0, else 0
score_rules.tui_launcher_presence_score: 10 if Astronomicon TUI console and windowed aquarium receipts PASS, else 0
